chunk_title: Superpowers, Critical Blindspots & Shadow Sides Across All 6 Archetypes

sections.title: Superpowers, Overuse Traps & Psychological Shadow Sides
bullets: The Dolphin delivers unmatched psychological safety and team cohesion as its superpower, but risks boundary erosion, chronic conflict-avoidance, and emotional burnout when its need for harmony prevents honest confrontation [DP-23].

The Fox delivers brilliant tactical agility and unconventional problem-solving, but risks devolving into perceived opportunism, cynicism, emotional detachment, and hiding behind an ironic mask to evade true vulnerability [DP-24].

The Lion provides decisive crisis leadership and unwavering vision, but under pressure risks steamrolling dissent, displaying abrasive impatience, and shutting down collaboration through unilateral command [DP-20].

The Owl contributes rigorous intellectual precision and infallible risk identification, but risks succumbing to analysis paralysis, hyper-critical skepticism, and appearing coldly aloof or unfeeling to emotional peers [DP-22].

The Peacock provides electrifying inspirational energy and high-voltage charisma, but risks attention-addiction, conversational hijacking, vulnerability to perceived rejection, and neglect of critical logistical follow-through [DP-21].

The Bear / Wolf provides profound emotional grounding and protective stability, but risks stubborn inertia against needed change, withdrawal into sullen isolation, and explosive delayed retaliation when pushed beyond its threshold [DP-25].

comparative_matrix.title: Cross-Archetype Superpowers & Shadow Sides Matrix
rows: Deep empathy, social cohesion, psychological safety
Cynical detachment, manipulative maneuvering, evasive masking
Decisive crisis authority, high-stakes clarity, direction
Indecision, perceived incompetence, slow deliberative pacing
Systemic precision, objective truth-telling, risk insight
Emotional drama, illogical arguments, forced social small talk
Cold dismissal, hyper-critical nitpicking, intellectual arrogance
Contagious enthusiasm, theatrical inspiration, stage magnetism
Social obscurity, lack of recognition, repetitive solitary tasks
Melodramatic victimhood, erratic moodiness, desperate validation seeking
Unshakeable calm, protective containment, loyal grounding
Sullen withdrawal / hibernation, explosive boundary enforcement

data_points.data_point: Lions excel in decisive goal-oriented leadership but risk becoming demanding, impatient, and insensitive under pressure
data_points.quoted_text: Strengths: Confident, decisive, goal-oriented, and natural leaders. They are excellent at taking charge and making quick decisions. Weaknesses: Can be perceived as demanding, impatient, or overly blunt. They may struggle to listen to others.
data_points.verification_query: "Lion" "Strengths: Confident, decisive, goal-oriented" "demanding, impatient, or overly blunt"
data_points.grep_result: Confident, decisive, goal-oriented, and natural leaders... Can be perceived as demanding, impatient, or overly blunt. They may struggle to listen to others

data_points.data_point: Peacocks provide visionary inspiration and social magnetism but struggle with detailed follow-through and emotional over-reaction
data_points.quoted_text: Strengths: Energetic, charismatic, fun-loving, and visionary. They excel at social interaction, networking, and inspiring others. Weaknesses: May struggle with follow-through or attention to detail ('shiny-object syndrome'). They can become overly dramatic or emotional under stress.
data_points.verification_query: "Peacock" OR "Otter" "shiny-object syndrome" "overly dramatic or emotional under stress"
data_points.grep_result: excel at social interaction, networking, and inspiring others... May struggle with follow-through or attention to detail ('shiny-object syndrome')... overly dramatic or emotional under stress

data_points.data_point: Owls deliver rigorous precision and risk analysis but suffer from analysis paralysis and interpersonal detachment
data_points.quoted_text: Strengths: Detail-oriented, analytical, systematic, and precise. They excel at planning, data analysis, and ensuring high-quality standards. Weaknesses: Can become 'paralyzed' by over-analyzing facts or be perceived as overly critical or detached.
data_points.verification_query: "Owl" "paralyzed by over-analyzing facts" OR "overly critical or detached"
data_points.grep_result: Detail-oriented, analytical, systematic, and precise... Can become 'paralyzed' by over-analyzing facts or be perceived as overly critical or detached

data_points.data_point: Dolphins maintain deep relational harmony and safety but are vulnerable to boundary loss and conflict-avoidance burnout
data_points.quoted_text: Loyal, patient, empathetic, and reliable. They are exceptional team players who excel at supporting others and maintaining harmony. Weaknesses: Often conflict-averse and may avoid standing up for themselves.
data_points.verification_query: "conflict-averse and may avoid standing up for themselves" "maintaining harmony"
data_points.grep_result: exceptional team players who excel at supporting others and maintaining harmony... Often conflict-averse and may avoid standing up for themselves

data_points.data_point: Foxes utilize strategic wit and adaptive survival but risk devolving into calculated manipulation, opportunism, and guarded masking
data_points.quoted_text: Manipulation vs. Persuasion: The fox's natural talent for reading and influencing others can devolve into calculated manipulation... Opportunism: a tendency to 'take' from situations... Guardedness and Isolation: keeping every plan hidden and every emotion behind a 'mask', preventing genuine connection to avoid being vulnerable.
data_points.verification_query: "The fox's natural talent for reading and influencing others can devolve into calculated manipulation" OR "keeping every plan hidden and every emotion behind a mask"
data_points.grep_result: natural talent for reading and influencing others can devolve into calculated manipulation... Opportunism... keeping every plan hidden and every emotion behind a mask

data_points.data_point: Bear and Wolf archetypes offer unyielding grounding and loyalty but exhibit stubborn resistance to change and explosive boundary retaliation
data_points.quoted_text: Bear personalities are the 'rock' in their social circles... but prefer sustained deep work over multitasking and can exhibit defensive boundaries: when pushed, they exhibit an immovable resolve, ensuring that they protect their territory or principles without conceding ground.
data_points.verification_query: "Bear personalities are the rock in their social circles" OR "immovable resolve, ensuring that they protect their territory"
data_points.grep_result: Bear personality is widely recognized as an archetype of steadiness, grounding, and protective strength... when pushed, they exhibit an immovable resolve
